d: Namaste, Hyundai India recently unveiled another 4-meter-plus SUV in its lineup: the Bayon. The car starts at Rs 9.99 lakh and goes up to Rs 18.14 Lakh for its top-end trim. With one engine and two gearbox options as of now, the Bayon is a very interesting offering and a little hard to understand for many. But I will try to make it easy for you. Here is a detailed SWOT analysis where I talk about all the important Pros and Cons of the car, along with suggestions on who should buy it or not. Along with the SWOT, I have also shared my driving impressions of both the 1.5L Manual and CVT…
